text:
mira (sec-eng): Quick Q — prepping AWS KMS for Redwood Private deploy in customer VPCs. Need a concise checklist covering control-plane vs data-plane keys, grants, CloudTrail audit, DEK caching/rotation, and incident playbook. Any gotchas?

sam (infra): I'll start a checklist. short bullets: control-plane CMK for metadata/config, data-plane CMK(s) for DEK wrapping, don't use same CMK for both :warning:.

derek (eng-runtime): agree. also note: use GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext on the control plane, and DEK never stored plaintext in S3/DB.

sam (infra): sample key policy snippet for cross-account usage:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "EnableCrossAccount",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/redwood-private"
      },
      "Action": [
        "kms:Encrypt",
        "kms:Decrypt",
        "kms:GenerateDataKey",
        "kms:ReEncrypt*"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

mira (sec-eng): also need IAM role trust and least privilege. prefer short-lived STS tokens + session tags for audit. add kms:ViaService when using AWS services.

tara (cust-suc): customer asked about BYOK/HSM options — do we support ImportKeyMaterial or CloudHSM backed CMKs?

sam (infra): we support both BYOK and KMS-imported keys. doc note: imported key material cannot be exported; rotation requires re-import and rewrap of existing DEKs.

derek (eng-runtime): DEK cache behavior: default 5m TTL; recommend caching per-tenant cache keys with LRU and explicit invalidation on rotation. Avoid caching plaintext longer than necessary.

mira (sec-eng): audit logging: require CloudTrail data events for kms:Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, enable key usage logging to S3/CloudWatch. Tie logs to account and session tags.

sam (infra): incident playbook quick steps: 1) revoke grants, 2) rotate CMK (create new CMK + rewrap DEKs), 3) invalidate caches + restart control-plane shards, 4) notify customers + rotate any leaked creds. Add checklist for runway to roll back.

derek (eng-runtime): vuln triage note — if KMS key policy misconfigured (wildcard principals), treat as SEV1, rotate immediately and review CloudTrail for suspicious Decrypt calls.

mira (sec-eng): outstanding items: provide exact KMS grant flow for our runtime, a small IAM role snippet, and a rewrap script prototype. Can one of you own docs + sample scripts?

sam (infra): I can own docs + IAM snippets. will drop a PR with examples (grant flow, role trust, import key steps) by EOD PST. :thumbsup:

mira (sec-eng): awesome, thx. ping me when PR ready and we'll run tabletop for incident flow.

jenkins-bot: Deployment pipeline triggered for branch kms-docs/pr-482 :rocket:

tara (cust-suc): :eyes: will share this thread with the customer liaison. thanks everyone!
